format: single concept illustration now; carousel copy and prompt pack only after creator approval

stage_scene_beats.scene: A warm dining table with rotis, plates, simple food, and father present as a side/back/off-frame conversation cue.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Zuv is angled toward father in conversation; Aachu is relaxed and eating beside him.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: Zuv's body is socially turned toward father, but Aachu is within easy hand/plate distance. Table objects are simple and not crowded.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The viewer understands the room has one conversation and one quiet couple rhythm.

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Show the roti bite becoming the moving object.
stage_scene_beats.scene: Zuv's fingers tear open a roti bite above his plate.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Before he eats it, Aachu's hand or mouth receives the prepared bite.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: His hand pauses mid-air; the torn roti edge shows the bite was just prepared.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The bite changes ownership without announcement.

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Show this is a pattern, not a one-off gag.
stage_scene_beats.scene: A small visual trace: one missing bite, one half-open roti, Aachu chewing naturally, Zuv still holding the remaining piece.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Father can still be gesturing or talking, implying the world continued while the tiny ritual repeated.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: Aachu's attention can be partly on the food; Zuv's attention has shifted to her face.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The private rhythm has become visible.

stage_scene_beats.scene: Zuv looks at Aachu's face, not at his missing bite.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Aachu eats with innocent comfort; Zuv's expression is amused, soft, and quietly surrendered.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: His hand is still open near the roti, showing he did not guard the bite. His eyes hold the emotional payoff.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: His gaze says this is not theft; this is belonging.

stage_scene_beats.scene: The table composition implies his plate and her plate have become one small shared world.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: No dramatic speech. The humor and tenderness live in the pause.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: Roti, plates, hands, and gaze form the emotional triangle.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The concept can be understood even if all text is hidden.

visual_watch_items: Do not make father the visual lead.
Do not use a full father likeness without a reference if final generation proceeds.
Do not overcrowd the table with too many dishes.
Do not show Aachu snatching aggressively.
Do not show Zuv annoyed or helpless.
Do not add speech bubbles or invented text.
Keep warm ivory/off-white paper, not yellow or parchment.
